Name: Alternate Portraits and Sprites for Columbina
Author: AirynS
Description:
Alternate portraits and sprites for Columbina from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44883]Columbina - Custom Genshin NPC [/url]by Sonix817. This mod will not work without Columbina because it’s an art replacer, so please download & endorse  Sonix817 ’s work.

To install, just unzip and drop the “Alternate Art for Columbina” folder into your Mods folder.

This was made as a gift for a friend and Sonix kindly gave me permission to upload it for others to use! I'm not taking requests for other NPCs, so please don't ask.

Manifest.Name: Alternate Art for Columbina
Manifest.Description: Changes Columbina's portraits & sprites to an alternate style by Airyn.
Manifest.Author: Airyn
